text: ひのとりのやまは　いつだって　でかいなあ…

patterns.name: 〜なあ
patterns.explanation: なあ at the end shows the speaker musing with feeling, mostly to himself. でかいなあ = 'it sure is huge...'

patterns.name: 〜だって
patterns.explanation: だって after a question word means 'no matter which', a casual でも. いつだって = 'whenever, always'.
